categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in engineering consulting services, including engineering supervision (monitoring), testing and inspection, tendering services, surveying and geographic information services, investigation and design, and other technical services. These services span multiple industries including roads, water transport, buildings, municipal utilities, water conservancy, natural resources, marine, mechanical and electrical installation, and agriculture.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes comprehensive engineering consulting methodologies combining economic, technical, commercial, legal, management, and information technologies. Key technical capabilities include full-process engineering consulting, satellite application technology (through subsidiary Jingwei Technology with involvement in Haixi satellite research), spatial-temporal big data services, and integrated sensing and intelligent monitoring systems. The company employs testing and inspection standards, surveying techniques, design methodologies, and digital transformation technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government departments, state-owned enterprises, and institutional clients (over 90% of receivables). The company serves infrastructure development projects, urban renewal initiatives, rural revitalization projects, and digital infrastructure construction. Key end markets include transportation infrastructure, municipal construction, environmental protection, natural resource management, and marine economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Fujian Province with headquarters in Fuzhou. Operations extend to other provinces including Guangdong, Zhejiang, Guangxi, Xinjiang, and Tibet. The company is strategically positioned to serve the Fuzhou metropolitan area and Xiamen-Zhangzhou-Quanzhou metropolitan area as defined in Fujian's urbanization planning.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a service provider in the midstream to downstream segments of the engineering and construction value chain. It provides consulting, supervision, testing, and design services that support project planning, implementation, and quality assurance throughout the construction lifecycle, rather than engaging in direct construction or material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) developing full-process engineering consulting capabilities integrating multiple service domains; (2) advancing satellite application technology and spatial-temporal big data services; (3) building integrated sensing and intelligent monitoring systems; (4) supporting Fujian's satellite application industry as a key enterprise; (5) promoting digital transformation and new quality productive forces; (6) expanding national market presence while consolidating Fujian market leadership.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through service fees for engineering consulting services including: engineering supervision contracts, testing and inspection services, tendering agency services, surveying and mapping services, design and consultation services, and technical services. Revenue is recognized upon service completion and customer acceptance, with some projects using percentage-of-completion method based on work progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading comprehensive engineering consulting enterprise in Fujian Province with significant market share in tendering services, engineering supervision, and testing. It competes with numerous regional and national engineering consulting firms. The company benefits from deep industry experience, multiple high-level qualifications, and strong regional brand recognition, though faces increasing competition from larger national firms and consolidation pressures in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized engineering consulting enterprise with 2023 revenue of approximately 686 million yuan, down 9.4% from 2022 (757 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 22.9 million yuan in 2023, down 57.8% from 2022 (50.6 million yuan). Total assets were 2.18 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company experienced significant profit decline in 2023 due to reduced project intake, slower project payments, and increased asset impairment provisions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive full-process engineering consulting capabilities spanning the entire project lifecycle; (2) extensive high-level qualifications across multiple engineering domains; (3) deep regional expertise and long-standing client relationships in Fujian; (4) innovative satellite and spatial-temporal big data applications; (5) integrated service delivery reducing client coordination costs; (6) strong technical talent base with numerous certified professionals; (7) proven track record on major infrastructure and public welfare projects.
